text: FC Barcelona (Barça) was founded on November 29, 1899, by a group of Swiss, Catalan, German, and English footballers led by Joan Gamper. The club is a symbol of Catalan culture and identity, with the famous motto "Més que un club" (More than a club).

FC Barcelona's home stadium is the Spotify Camp Nou (often called Camp Nou), the "Cathedral of Football". Opened in 1957, it is the largest stadium in Europe with a seating capacity of 99,354, and is currently undergoing renovations to upgrade the venue.

La Masia is FC Barcelona's world-renowned youth academy, known as "The Talent Factory". It has developed legendary world-class talents like Lionel Messi, Xavi Hernandez, Andrés Iniesta, Sergio Busquets, and current superstar Lamine Yamal.
FC Barcelona's trophy cabinet includes 28 La Liga Titles, 5 UEFA Champions League (UCL) trophies, 32 Copa del Rey trophies, and 16 Spanish Super Cups (Supercopa de España).

The coaching staff for the 2025/2026 season is led by Hansi Flick (Head Coach), bringing high-intensity football and tactical discipline. He is assisted by Heiko Westermann (Assistant Coach, defensive specialist) and Toni Tapalovic (Goalkeeping Coach).
